coverage.scope: The authenticated profile activity feed and its articles tab as previously captured. Articles can also have feed announcement posts; do not sum the two counts as unique publications.
coverage.limits: This is a captured inventory, not proof of every historical LinkedIn item. Unverified dates and URLs require direct post review. A linked note is not proof that its introducing post text has been migrated.

policy.include: Original posts and articles, including short observations, announcements, and commentary on links. Preserve original wording and publication dates.
policy.third_party: Keep third-party authorship clear; omit unadorned reposts; retain only Ian’s own commentary when quoting another post.
policy.existing_notes: Link to long notes where they already exist. Mark a post represented only after checking its own text, not merely its link.
policy.publication: Prepare drafts on main and review before publication; no separate branches.
policy.dates: Keep exact LinkedIn publication timestamps and record the calendar-date basis. Do not use migration or filesystem dates as original publication dates.
